gbm_population_evidence.quote: Trial of Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy and Stereotactic Radiation in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma
Confirmed histologic diagnosis of WHO Grade IV, Glioblastoma Multiforme

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety/tolerability/feasibility of pembrolizumab and radiation therapy before surgical resection in patients with recurrent glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: GBM recurrence or progression with planned standard of care surgical resection and repeat radiation

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the T cell clonality, CD8 T cell activation and Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) score after treatment.

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab 400mg administered intravenously on Day 1, and then beginning 6 weeks post-surgery, subjects will receive 400 mg pembrolizumab every 6 weeks

arms: Pembrolizumab with stereotactic radiation therapy and surgical resection

biomarkers.biomarker_other: T cell clonality, CD8 T cell activation and tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) score

source_quote.quote: To assess the T cell clonality, CD8 T cell activation and Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) score after treatment.

coder_notes: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab + stereotactic RT before resection in recurrent GBM; single arm. Immune PD markers (T cell clonality/CD8 activation from blood; TIL score) recorded as pharmacodynamic 'other'. 'WHO Grade IV, Glioblastoma Multiforme' -> historical.
